# Toolbar extension ordering uses the ID when install dates tie

registerExtension sorts by install-date value and falls back to id.localeCompare when the subtraction is falsy, including equal valid dates. Missing add-ons produce a warning but still register with a new Date fallback. The default toolbar consumes this stored order after space filtering. The existing unregister/re-register test checks array stability for two known themes; it does not force a timestamp tie or establish a fresh fix for the intermittent failure.

Scope: Unified toolbar extension registration.
